incident_updates.body:
We're aware of an issue affecting access to TelemetryTV. All login methods are currently returning an error, and users are unable to access the platform. TelemetryTV is actively working to restore access.
 
• All login methods are currently unavailable.
• Users are unable to access their accounts or make changes to the platform.
• Existing content saved on digital signage players should continue playing normally while access is being restored.
 
We're following up with TelemetryTV for further updates. We don't yet have a confirmed timeline for when platform access will be restored, but we'll share more information in this channel as it becomes available.

incidents.name: Wireless connectivity issues for Macs - November 4, 2026 - 13:00 PT

incident_updates.body:
After investigating, UBC IT technicians have determined that a recent required network upgrade resulted in some older devices being unable to connect to UBC's networks. UBC's wireless network remains fully functional, and most up-to-date devices are able to connect.

We strongly recommend that all clients ensure their devices are up to date with the latest versions of their operating system. For Macs this is MacOS 27.2.1, and for iPhone/iPad this is iOS version 27.2.1.

If your phone or computer is unable to update to the latest version, clients may opt to use the UBC IoT network as an alternative, if connecting from on-campus. More information about the IoT network can be found at https://it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/ubc-internet-things-iot-wi-fi.

Noted workarounds appear to be working for affected users.
Technicians are still monitoring the issue; however, recommendation is to apply one of the workarounds/fixes.

Issue is still being investigated.

For workarounds:

1. Update your MacOS operating system
2. Use the UBCIoT Wifi network (https://it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/ubc-internet-things-iot-wi-fi)

There is currently an issue that some Mac devices are unable to connect to the UBC wireless networks.

Technicians are investigating the issue.

Next update will be at 15:00

scheduled_maintenances.name: UBCIT eSAM Servers Maintenance Nov. 19, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT

incident_updates.body:
UBCIT will be performing maintenance on the eSAM component and vault servers on Nov. 19, 2026, 20:00-23:00 PT. This change will affect both UBC campuses.

Users will intermittently not be able to login to any servers managed by eSAM, nor retrieve any credentials via the eSAM Web UI throughout the maintanance window. 

Any connections terminated while a component is being rebooted can be reconnected to the secondary node. All connections will be terminated and users won't be able to reconnect while we patch the vault servers (which typically lasts around 30 minutes) during this window.

scheduled_maintenances.name: BC time zone change for UBC managed MacOS devices October 20, 2026, 16:00 PT

incident_updates.body: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

UBC IT will be preparing end user devices for the transition to the new BC time zone (PCT, UTC -7:00).  MacOS devices that are currently set to America/Los_Angeles, America/Tijuana or US/Pacific (PST/PDT) will be transitioned to America/Vancouver to address the new time zone for British Columbia.  We realize this may impact a small number of devices operating outside BC (Washington, Oregon, California) that may need to be corrected after this change.
